description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Understanding and Mitigating Wind Effects on Low-Rise Building Roofs is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arindam Gan Chowdhury, Florida International University (fiu.edu). Current research to reduce the harm created by hurricanes involves a mitigation plan in the formation of an Aerodynamics Mitigation and Power System (AMPS) (US Patent, Gan Chowdhury et al., Patent Number: US 9,951,752 B2, April 2018) designed to reduce wind damage and provide power to buildings simultaneously. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-n0wx-e932. Keywords: NHERI Wall of Wind; Mitigating; Wind Effects; Low-Rise Buildings. Published 2023-08-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
